snippet.title: Rogue Quest - Trailer
snippet.description:
Roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands deal the damage. Try the free demo of RogueQuest, a dark fantasy card game roguelike launching in Early Access on Steam May 19, 2026.

🎴 Play the free demo (browser, no download): https://curds-crowns.itch.io/rogue-quest
🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669610/Rogue_Quest/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/jKEC9VgE9w

RogueQuest is a singleplayer roguelike deckbuilding card game inspired by Slay the Spire, Balatro, and Monster Train. Build poker hands (pair, flush, straight, full house, straight flush) to deal damage. Draft cards between fights, forge enhancements, collect power cards with passive abilities, and fight your way through procedurally generated dungeon floors.

Features:
- 5 character classes with unique decks
- 88 power cards
- Poker hand combat system
- Procedurally generated maps
- Dark fantasy painterly art
- Town meta-progression
- Mythic trials and oaths
